text:
Carla: OK team — kicking off a narrow-scope onboarding for Azure CSP + EU data residency. Goal: get a minimal listing that supports enterprise trial entitlements, SSO provisioning, and KMS-backed AMIs by next Wednesday.

Ben: pls confirm legal EULA variant for EU customers — do we need localized terms or can we use the standard redwood EULA with a data-residency addendum? :thinking: 

Dmitri: Prefer localized terms. Marketplace sometimes rejects generic EULAs for CSP listings. I'll sync with legal but need the exact text by EOD Tue.

Elaine: On infra — we need to know which AMI/VM images we can publish (CSP has image scan requirements). Harpreet, can you surface the current hardened image IDs and KMS key ARNs?

Harpreet: pulling list now. Quick Q: will trial VMs be single-tenant or shared? That affects AMI packaging and telemetry.

Carla: Trial should be tenant-scoped (customer gets trial instance). We want telemetry opt-in by default for metric aggregation but must present clear consent per EU regs.

Ben: For consent we should include a short checkbox flow in the trial provisioning UI and an EULA clause. I'll draft an addendum: "Telemetry & Usage Data — opt-in for product analytics; necessary for trial support."

Dmitri: Thanks. Also need SKU mapping for trial vs paid. Marketplace requires distinct offer SKUs for free trial, paid subscription, and metered add-ons. Sample mapping below — can someone validate?

Elaine: drop it here, I'll check technical constraints.

Dmitri: ```yaml
sku_mapping:
  - sku_id: RDW-AZ-TRIAL-EU
    type: trial
    entitlements: [core_api, 10_000_tokens]
  - sku_id: RDW-AZ-STANDARD-EU
    type: subscription
    entitlements: [core_api, 1M_tokens]
  - sku_id: RDW-AZ-ADDON-EMB
    type: metered
    entitlements: [embeddings_per_1k]
```

Harpreet: mapping looks fine. One gotcha: CSP metadata rejects underscores in SKU IDs in some regions. Recommend hyphens only.

Dmitri: Good catch — will update.

Ben: Legal asks that trial entitlements include a visible expiration timestamp and auto-conversion terms (if any). Also need refund clause for accidental charge — marketplace required?

Carla: marketplace handles billing but we should provide a clear conversion flow. Let's add auto-expire + email 3 days before end.

Elaine: Technical checklist from infra: AMI scan report, boot-time init script, KMS key ARN, telemetry endpoint allowlist, and SSH key rotation docs. I can produce a skeleton runbook.

marketplace-bot: Reminder — Marketplace submission window opens at 09:00 PT on Wednesday. Upload asset bundle (images + manifests) at least 48h prior for validation.

Carla: Timeline proposal: Tue EOD — legal EULA addendum, SKU hyphenated list; Wed AM — infra AMI + KMS ARNs; Wed 09:00 PT — upload bundle for validation; Fri — expected validation results. If any blocking, escalate to cloud-partner-ops.

Ben: I'll have the addendum by Tue 17:00 PT.

Harpreet: AMI list and KMS ARNs in infra-safe bucket by Wed 07:30 PT. I'll paste links here when ready.

Elaine: I'll draft the runbook and the provisioning snippet for the trial (includes checkbox consent, expiry metadata) and post it here by Tue noon.

Dmitri: I'll update SKU IDs, add the 3-day email trigger, and prep the marketplace metadata JSON.

Carla: blockers?

Dmitri: Need Marketing signoff on trial marketing text used in the listing (preview copy). @marketing to weigh in?

Carla: ping marketing offline; adding to checklist.

marketplace-bot: Upload checklist template: https://internal.redwood/integrations/marketplace/checklist-template-v2.pdf

Ben: thumbs up on timeline. Also: privacy team wants the telemetry endpoint domain allowlist and the retention window documented. I'll need that before final sign-off.

Harpreet: retention window for trial telemetry = 30 days by default, can extend with customer contract. Will document.

Elaine: I'll include telemetry endpoint and retention in runbook. Also adding the sample provisioning payload we send to marketplace: ```json
{"offerId":"RDW-AZ-STANDARD-EU","trialExpires":"2025-07-21T12:00:00Z","consent":true}
```

Carla: Great. Let's reconvene Tue 16:00 PT to confirm all artifacts before upload. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
